description: Fictional producer contract for two-hour press-line sensor features. Synthetic teaching policy, not a Databricks behaviour.
feature_time: feature_time: end of the two-hour window (start, end] that the row describes
availability_time: available_at: time of the scheduled run that published this version of the row

temp_mean_2h.rule: mean of temp_c over readings in the window

vib_max_2h.rule: max of non-null vibration_mm_s; null when the window has no vibration value

vib_count_2h.rule: non-null vibration values in the window; never more than reading_count_2h

source_max_ingested_at.rule: latest ingested_at among the readings used; never after available_at
